name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.1-beta+12

- Right-click on Stremio grid cards
- Like/Love/Dislike everywhere, card menu, skip intros & credits, Up next, mini player, error log
  - Dislike next to Like and Love; anime pages get Like / Love / Dislike too, and Home's For you learns from them
  - One card menu for anime and Movies & TV: long-press on iPhone, right-click on Windows (Play next episode, Library, Like / Love / Dislike, Not interested)
  - Skip intros, recaps and credits on TV shows and movies (TheIntroDB or the video's chapters)
  - Up next: countdown when the credits start, or a Next episode button near the end
  - Windows mini player that stays on top
  - Self Test keeps the last 50 errors, ready to copy
  - Restoring an AnymeX backup now brings back AnymeX+ settings right away
